detail: Config validation (fn-inj-configp, books/injection.lisp:592-601; the moderation entries it carries are checked only for cons shape by fn-nntp-moderated-entryp, books/nntp-responses.lisp:306-311) admits (1) a group or moderation-queue name wider than the record codec's group-name width (*fn-record-max-group-name*, 256 octets; books/records-shape.lisp) and (2) a group or queue name containing CR or LF. (1): P9's c9 built a valid ICFG with a 900-octet moderated source group (post-acc build/post-runs/l2/c9/A1-COUNTEREXAMPLE.lsp); its envelope Subject carries the name (books/moderation.lisp:221-231). (2): P10's c9 K-LINE run spliced a queue holding CRLF + headers + body into the envelope's Newsgroups line, PRE 13646 (c9/K-LINE-COUNTEREXAMPLE.lsp): header injection. Coordinator DECISION (c), 2026-10-12: POST landing 2 makes fn-mod-forward refuse a malformed entry (:moderation-unavailable) through one well-formedness predicate defined in books/moderation.lisp, so the envelope is closed at its producer. This item is DEFENCE IN DEPTH: config validation also rejects group and queue names wider than 256 octets or carrying CR/LF, citing that predicate (no twin).
notes: 10-12 19:54 P10: widened per coordinator DECISION (c) condition 3 (CR/LF in group and queue names; cite the moderation well-formedness predicate landing 2 defines)
source: Coordinator DECISION 2026-10-12 (P9's A1 RED, option (ii) filed as hygiene)
title: Config admits group and queue names wider than the record codec, or carrying CR/LF
